standards.title: Analyze the causes and consequences of industrialization

blocks.name: Hook — Gilded or Golden?
blocks.lead: Look at the political cartoon your teacher projects. What is the artist claiming?

blocks.label: Do Now
paras: Write one sentence: was the Gilded Age good or bad for ordinary Americans? You will revise this claim at the end of the lesson.

blocks.name: Guided Notes — The New Economy
blocks.lead: Take Cornell notes as your teacher works through the direct-instruction slides.

head: Prompt
Your response
rows: Name one technology that fueled industrial growth and explain how.
Explain one cost of industrialization for workers.
